method: Wash the tomatoes and wipe them with a dry cloth.
Chop the tomatoes into small pieces.
Clean the tamarind by removing seeds and fibers.
Dry roast the mustard seeds and fenugreek individually and powder them.
In a pan, add a little oil and sauté the chopped tomatoes and tamarind until the tomatoes turn mushy and the moisture evaporates.
Add the salt and red chili powder, and continue to sauté for a few more minutes.
Add the rest of the oil and the powdered mustard-fenugreek mixture.
Mix well and simmer until the oil starts to separate.
Allow it to cool and store in a clean, dry glass jar.
